refused.message:
refusal[ESS-SYNTH-012]: entity metrics.session.Session has no scenario `metrics.session.Session/state/Completed/refuses/metrics.session.Complete`
  `metrics.session.Complete` on a `metrics.session.Session` in `Completed` is refused and the specification does not say how: no `wrong_state:` outcome and no declared error, so the scenario can only require that nothing happened
  help: give the command a `wrong_state:` outcome naming the error it reports; the states it answers in are already declared, as the states its transitions do not run from

refusal[ESS-SYNTH-016]: view metrics.session.ByChannel has no scenario `metrics.session.ByChannel/aggregate`
  `metrics.session.ByChannel` reports exact aggregates, and no group key or parameter lets this scenario keep its rows apart from every other scenario's on a shared target
  help: group by, or filter by a parameter over, a `String` or `Uuid` field the creating command sets from its input

refusal[ESS-SYNTH-017]: view metrics.session.Either has no scenario `metrics.session.Either/aggregate`
  `metrics.session.Either` cannot be arranged: the parameter `queue_id` is read other than by one top-level `field == param.queue_id` conjunct over a field that is not a group key
  help: let the creating command set every field the view groups by or aggregates from its input, and read a parameter only as `field == param.name` at the top of the filter
